domain: regulatory inspections of cannabis licence holders (Cannabis Act compliance program)
prediction_question: Hypothetical task this source supports (rejected on family and capacity): for a cannabis licence holder with at least one completed Health Canada inspection, will its NEXT inspection be rated Non-compliant rather than Compliant, given only what is knowable before the next inspection starts (holder identity, province, prior inspection types, time since last inspection)?
prediction_time: Would be the next inspection's start date (the rows carry 'Inspection start date'), with prior-inspection history as features - a clean event-time formulation in principle.
target_definition: 'Inspection rating' column (measured values: Compliant / Non-compliant / Rating not assigned), assigned by Health Canada inspectors under the Cannabis Act compliance and enforcement program - a documented process. The label is fine; the panel is not (see split_strategy).

license_evidence: Measured 2026-10-22 via CKAN package_search: package e04d55cd-74dd-4167-a9ea-c6eb9e9ab287, license_title 'Open Government Licence - Canada', organization 'Health Canada | Sante Canada'. licence_class A: redistribution and derivatives permitted with attribution and no-endorsement conditions, to be stated in LICENSE.md if ever built. The licence was NOT the blocker.
split_strategy: Measured, and it fails twice over. (1) Depth: the package publishes per-inspection CSVs semi-annually and its oldest resource was created 2025-01-22; the published universe is 4 half-year vintages covering inspection start years 2023(6 rows)/2024(498)/2025(728)/2026(126 through September) = 1,358 inspection rows. Three disjoint train/eval/holdout windows with both classes cannot be drawn from 4 periods of a 2.5-year register. (2) Positives and panel grain: 66 Non-compliant rows in total (base rate 4.9% of 1,358; 1,291 Compliant, 1 'Rating not assigned'), and a next-outcome panel needs repeat inspections - 278 holders have >=2 inspections (815 rows, max 15 for one holder), so the transition panel carries at most a few hundred rows and at most 66 positives, clustered in time.

measurements.probes_2026_10_22: See notes.md for exact commands. All four English CSVs fetched anonymously (302 -> 200 via redirect, sizes 30,716-51,318 bytes), parsed locally.
measurements.shape: 8 columns: Licence holder name, Province or territory, Inspection start date, Inspection type, Sampling Conducted, Observations, Inspection rating, Measures initiated by Health Canada. 1,358 data rows across the 4 vintages.
measurements.inspection_type_mix: Regular 916, Targeted 209, CV 128, Compliance Verification 88, Compliance Monitoring Projects 17 (130 rows in the first pass were blank-liners, resolved in the second pass).
measurements.holder_grain: 821 distinct licence holders; 278 with >=2 inspections (815 rows); maximum 15 inspections for a single holder.
measurements.file_hygiene_note: Measured inconsistency across vintages: the 2025-04/09 file uses lowercase headers and is not valid UTF-8 (a Latin-1 fallback is needed), the other three use capitalized headers with a UTF-8 BOM - a construction would need per-file header/encoding normalization. Recorded as a cost note, not the rejection reason.

rejection_reason: REJECTED on two independent grounds, either of which closes it. (1) Task-family mirror: the natural task on this source is establishment -> next-inspection-rating prediction, the exact task already live on this bench as fsa-fhrs-next-rating (UK FSA food-hygiene next rating, GO to construction) and present in the chicago-food-inspections family; a Canadian re-issue changes the jurisdiction and publisher, not the task - the same comparison that rejected hc-recalls-classification against openFDA prior art and jma-typhoon-rapid-intensification against TCRISI. (2) Measured capacity: 4 published half-year vintages (2.5 years), 1,358 inspections, 66 positives (4.9%), 278 repeat holders - three disjoint windows with both classes are not possible. Licence and access are both clean (OGL-Canada, anonymous CSVs); neither was the blocker.
next_action: None - dropped. Do not reopen for next-inspection-rating or current-inspection-outcome formulations while fsa-fhrs-next-rating is live; a genuinely different task on this source (one that is not about the inspection rating) would need a fresh novelty check first. Sibling observation recorded in the same pass: the 'Vaping Compliance and Enforcement Data Summary (retail inspections)' package (c7c556dc-a4c2-4259-9f74-a1cde5e42c4b, OGL-Canada) has the same inspection-outcome shape on an annual cadence with a single 2024-25 vintage online - closed by the same family and capacity reasoning.
